# Semler Teaches / Semler Web Services

> Jeremiah Semler is a high school wood shop teacher in Cambridge, Minnesota who runs two
> things from semlerteaches.com: Semler Teaches (life skills, basic trades, and everyday
> fixes content, plus classroom resources for his students) and Semler Web Services (websites
> and AI training for local small businesses in east-central Minnesota).

## Semler Web Services (for local businesses)

Fast, no-nonsense websites for trades and local businesses. Flat prices quoted in writing,
changes live within 2 business days, and the customer's domain always stays theirs.

- Website builds: professional mobile-first sites, flat price quoted up front, from $1,200
- Care plans: hosting, security, and updates from $50/month with a plain-English monthly report
- Google Business Profile setup and cleanup: included with every build
- AI training for small businesses: plain-English training for owners and their crews —
  real tools, real examples, no hype, taught by a working teacher

Service area: east-central Minnesota — Cambridge, Isanti, North Branch, Braham, Princeton,
Milaca, Mora, Rush City, Zimmerman, East Bethel, and nearby towns.

Contact: semlerwebservices@gmail.com · 320-425-0080 (call or text)
Details: https://semlerteaches.com/#web-services

## Semler Teaches (teaching and content)

Life skills, basic trades, and everyday fixes from a real shop teacher — on TikTok,
Instagram, and YouTube as @semlerteaches. Classroom resources for his students live at
https://semlerteaches.com/classroom.html (class code required). Wood shop lesson plans for
other teachers are coming to Teachers Pay Teachers and Etsy:
https://semlerteaches.com/lesson-plans.html
